caseName: Buck v. Board of Medical Examiners
caseNameFull: Buck v. Board of Medical Examiners of Oregon
attorneys: Ralph E. Moody for appellant. Howard I. Bobbitt for appellee.

opinions.text:
Appeal from the Supreme Court of Oregon.

Per Curiam:

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for the want of a substantial federal question.

Mr. Justice Burton took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
